sourceSelection: Reviewed Full tone 237 for every Fit; reviewed native model001 for every Large.

resources.publicationTableChanges: Existing rows/columns preserved; release-row display names use stock/custom TLK names.

installedGameDependencies: Unmodified stock head textures/palettes and optional stock materials for routing aliases.
Stock Human head001 models; alias heads for other body slots retain their existing stock geometry.
limits: Troll intentionally replaces the Gnome body slot G; Halfling is out of scope.
Stock head001 supplies assembly context; other heads and finished armor wardrobes are outside validation.
Clothing proof covers representative solid modular garments; weighted robes and cloaks need a separate route.
Client checks sampled motions and palettes; all-frame/all-palette acceptance is not claimed.
A pre-existing client exit crash remains documented; no in-session crash was observed during final checks.
publicationNotes: Reviewed Fit model237 is renamed to production model001 using fixed-width model/node name fields only. Selected palette bytes are copied unchanged to model001.
Native raw geometry, normals, tangents, UVs, faces, transforms and animation arrays are unchanged. Large models and fitted rig closures are byte-identical.

Contract 1.1.0 follows the stock supermodel structure: each non-Human Fit and Large root names one shared library srn_an_<race><gender> over the installed a_fa/a_ba chain; Human Large roots name srn_fa_h0 (female) or a_ba (male) like Human Fit.
Library clips are byte-exact copies of the published clips; clips inherited from stock had identical keys in the published chain. The female Large 2hslashl uses the Fit clip as authorized.
Body palettes and skin maps above 1024 px are reduced 2:1 by area; names, formats, materials and PLT files are unchanged.

1.2.0: model roots sit at the origin, as in the stock rigs. Each non-Human rig and library root offset was folded into rootdummy, handconjure and headconjure and the library rootdummy keys (root-rebase/root-rebase-receipt.json); bind and library clip world frames are unchanged within float32 rounding.

1.3.0 (user-approved 2026-10-27; docs/phenomorpher/race-sizing/plan.md, human-bodies-lock-c7.md): race bodies at their lore rest heights with Fit = Large, Large-male joint heights at Fit, lore build, the b13/c6 female joins ported to the race females, idle soles on the floor; the c7 Human lock (c6 female joins, torso polish and rebuilt skin, and pmh2 at Fit joint heights). Rigs, libraries and pmh2 compile with Blender 5.2.1 + Neverblender 4.5.1 against the stock a_ba/a_fa. Per-resource release130 records the 1.2.0 hash and change class.

runtimeOptimization.rollback: Restore contract 1.0.0 and its resources from commit 0866bcaf.
